Title: Tenant-aware user authentication
Acceptance_Criteria: Cognito sign-in and MFA; unauthorized tenant access denied.

Title: Customer membership and roles
Acceptance_Criteria: Admins manage customers; members limited to own customers.

Title: Environment and CI/CD
Acceptance_Criteria: Dev/stage/prod deployments and rollback reproducible.

Title: Customer/project administration
Acceptance_Criteria: Admin creates customer/project and assigns members.

Title: App directory and navigation
Acceptance_Criteria: Project selector and app tiles show only authorized links.

Title: Secure existing Lambda links
Acceptance_Criteria: Direct application URL does not bypass authorization.

Title: Project Overview
Acceptance_Criteria: Manual health, notes, quick links and aggregate basic summary.

Title: Secure file upload/download
Acceptance_Criteria: Tenant scoped S3 authorization, version metadata.

Title: Basic file versions and Recycle Bin
Acceptance_Criteria: Versions retrievable; soft delete and single restore audited.

Title: GitHub App and mapping
Acceptance_Criteria: Repository, Project and issue identifiers mapped without exposing credentials.

Title: Reliable two-way sync
Acceptance_Criteria: Webhook ingestion, outgoing API, retries, reconciliation and status.

Title: Task table and estimates
Acceptance_Criteria: Issue and numeric effort estimates editable and synchronized.

Title: Weighted project progress
Acceptance_Criteria: Leaf-only effort; unestimated=1; no tasks yields no percentage.

Title: Explained manual override
Acceptance_Criteria: Explanation mandatory; automatic figure retained and audited.

Title: Basic Kanban
Acceptance_Criteria: Move issue statuses on board with GitHub sync.

Title: On-demand report workflow
Acceptance_Criteria: Draft, review, approval, publish, version history.

Title: Core audit logging
Acceptance_Criteria: Actor/time/changes and restore events recorded.

Title: Pilot acceptance and security tests
Acceptance_Criteria: Security, recovery, synchronization and customer scenario gates pass.

Title: Gantt with task date edits
Acceptance_Criteria: Drag/resize task; validate and sync changes.

Title: Dependency preview and approval
Acceptance_Criteria: Show downstream changes before approval; conflicts flagged if rejected.

Title: Hierarchy completion rules
Acceptance_Criteria: Rollups, cascade Done/reopen and blocking invalid parent completion.

Title: Hybrid milestone tracking
Acceptance_Criteria: Target vs forecast; manual confirmation; required reason to reopen.

Title: Admin-approved immutable snapshots
Acceptance_Criteria: Baseline 1 admin-created; later proposals and approval retain history.

Title: Baseline variance classification
Acceptance_Criteria: Newly Scheduled / Added / Removed compared to selected baseline.

Title: Cursor report draft importer
Acceptance_Criteria: GitHub Actions/Lambda register draft for AWS review.

Title: Context-aware AI status report
Acceptance_Criteria: Previous published report, plan, board and activity available.

Title: Advanced report change insight
Acceptance_Criteria: Baseline and task changes reported without unverified claims.

Title: Selective descendant restore
Acceptance_Criteria: Parent restore lists deleted descendants and validates hierarchy.

Title: Partial bulk restoration
Acceptance_Criteria: Restore valid; conflict results; retry failed only and audit individually.

Title: Restore-as-version approval
Acceptance_Criteria: Review candidate version; preserve current until explicit activation.

Title: Side-by-side document comparison
Acceptance_Criteria: Text diff supported; metadata fallback.

Title: Advanced recovery and retention
Acceptance_Criteria: Indefinite version retention; admin-only permanent deletion.
